commitments.detail: Customer data shall be deleted within 30 days of request.
The vendor is not permitted to use customer support chat or call transcripts for model training.
All processing of customer data will occur within the US region.
Vendor must maintain cyber insurance coverage of at least $500,000.
The company will be named as an additional insured party under the vendor's cyber insurance policy.
The vendor must provide annual audits to ensure compliance with the agreement terms.
The vendor is required to indemnify the company against any claims related to the use of their AI platform, with no cap on the amount.
